folder.description: Parent folder directory (name only — no .folder suffix). If the folder already exists, its kind wins; otherwise `folderKind` decides whether to create a workspace folder (.folder/) or a multi-page canvas group (plain dir).

folderKind.description: When `folder` is set and doesn't yet exist: `workspace` creates `<folder>.folder/` (each canvas appears under a workspace folder header), `pages` creates a plain `<folder>/` dir (canvases become pages of a shared multi-page group). Ignored when the folder already exists.
